question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**has**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about 'a child' which is singular, so we need the verb form that agrees with the singular subject.
 
• 'Has' is the correct choice as it agrees with the singular subject 'child' (a child has good parents).
 
• Other options like **have** are incorrect because they do not agree with the singular subject 'child'.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Childhood is a time when there are few responsibilities to make life difficult. If a child (1) has__ good parents and they are fed, looked after and loved, whatever they may do, it is improbable that they will ever again in life (2)_____ given so much without having to do anything in return. In addition, life is always presenting new things to the child. A child finds pleasure in playing in the rain or in the snow. Their first visit to the seaside is a marvelous adventure. However, a child has their pains; they are not free to do as they wish; they are continually being told not to do things or are being (3)_____. Their life is therefore not perfectly happy. When the young individual starts to earn their own living, they become free from the discipline of school and parents, but at the same time they are forced to accept responsibilities. They can no longer expect others to pay for food, clothes and room, but they have to work if they want to live (4)_____. If they spend most of their time playing about in the way that they used to as a child, they will go hungry. Moreover, if they break the laws of society just as they used to break the laws of their parents, they may go to prison. However, by working, keeping out of (5)_____ and having good health, they can have the great happiness of seeing themselves make steady progress in their job and of building up for themselves their own position in society.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Have**: This is incorrect as it is a plural form, and the subject 'a child' is singular, so it does not agree grammatically.
 
• **Are**: This would suggest a plural subject and is incorrect in this context where 'a child' is singular.
 
• **Will**: This is future tense and doesn't match the present general description of a child's situation in the passage.
